title: Multimodal RewardBench: Holistic Evaluation of Reward Models for Vision Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to images of individuals of different genders using the PAIRS dataset to test for unwarranted associations with attributes like occupations, crime, or socioeconomic status, expecting models to select the unbiased 'unclear' response rather than making stereotyped judgments.
